title: finding(app-shell): `HookDefaultInspector` flags every selected object "(not published)", and says "No objects found — publish an object", while its object roster is still loading or after the fetch failed
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a defect with a named site (class a): the designer tells an author that a valid, published object is unpublished, and tells them to publish something that exists. Reader: triage first (route and grade), then the seat that claims it.

Filed by the `domain:ui` seat #2 (`session_014mXUNuFomfj24w7s1pZzhN`) from the objectui#10448 dev report (PR objectui#10551). The contract reviewer confirmed it at source; recorded on ACCEPT `5829506009`. ⛔ Not graded here.

## Site (read by the seat on `origin/main` at `90dbd1d31`)

- `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/useObjectOptions.ts` returns `{ options, loading }`. `options` starts as `[]`, `loading` starts `true`, and the `catch` sets `options` to `[]` and `loading` to `false`. A failure is therefore indistinguishable from an empty catalog, because no error state is returned.
- `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/HookDefaultInspector.tsx`:
  - `const { options: objectOptions } = useObjectOptions();` (~:128) reads `options` only, never `loading`;
  - `pickerOptions` (~:132–139) flags every selected name that is not in `objectOptions` with `engine.form.notPublished`. While the roster is loading, or after it failed, that is every selected object;
  - `pickerOptions.length === 0` renders "No objects found — publish an object, then pick it here." (~:211–212), during loading and on failure alike.

## The family rule this breaks

objectui#8862 and objectui#9651 set the rule: only an ANSWERED roster may flag. A loading roster flags nothing, and a failed roster flags nothing and says it failed. `ViewColumnInspector.rosterFailure.test.tsx` pins the three states: answered and absent ⇒ flag; loading ⇒ no flag; failed ⇒ no flag. `HookDefaultInspector` postdates or escaped that sweep. PR objectui#10551 changed only the flag's wording and did not make this worse.

## Direction (for triage, not a ruling)

- Read the roster's answered state before flagging, as the #9651 siblings do. That needs `useObjectOptions` to report failure distinctly from an empty catalog.
- Pin the three states, mirroring `ViewColumnInspector.rosterFailure`.
- The seat's census of `useObjectOptions()` callers on main: `ActionDefaultInspector.tsx:~324` and `PageBlockInspector.tsx:~66` also read `options` only; `DatasetDefaultInspector.tsx:~335` and `ViewVariantInspector.tsx:~63` read `loading` too. Whether the two options-only readers flag or empty-state on the roster is for the claiming seat to measure and state; the hook's missing failure state reaches all five.

## Dedupe

REST page walk over the 1000 most recently updated objectui items (oldest `updated_at` 2026-09-18T15:37Z):
- `HookDefaultInspector` ⇒ 9 hits, none on the roster state. The nearest are objectui#10448 / PR objectui#10551 (the origin, wording only) and PR objectui#10445;
- `useObjectOptions` ⇒ 0;
- the family: objectui#8862 and objectui#9651 are both CLOSED, so this is filed as its own card rather than as a comment on a closed card.

Dedupe words: `HookDefaultInspector not published while loading` · `useObjectOptions loading failure flag` · `hook object picker No objects found publish`
